order.description: Represents a single outbound customer order captured in WMS, containing all customer, billing, shipping, carrier, delivery and freight information.

order_creation.description: Refers to orders that were created/entered in the system, based on order_date.

order_number.description: Unique external order identifier used to reference the customer order.

order_id.description: Internal system-generated unique primary key for each order.

warehouse.description: Identifies the warehouse/facility where the order is being processed.

customer.description: Customer placing the order, including name, PO, phone, fax, email.

customer_po.description: Customer-provided PO number linked to the order.

billing_address.description: Billing party details including address, city, state, postal code, and phone.

shipping_address.description: Recipient's address where the order will be shipped.

delivery_address.description: Final delivery location details for shipment completion.

status.description: Represents the current state of the order (e.g., created, picked, shipped).

picking.description: Represents the picking activity completion for the order.

shipping.description: Refers to the shipment of the order using a designated carrier based on actual_ship_date.

delivery.description: Indicates final delivery of the order to ship-to/delivery address.

carrier.description: Represents the logistics provider used to ship the order.

freight.description: Includes freight terms and total shipping/transportation cost.

rush_priority.description: Represents urgency level of the order.

dates.description: All date-related fields including order, arrival, pick, ship, and delivery dates.

hazmat.description: Indicates whether the order contains hazardous material.

weight_volume.description: Total weight and volume of the order used for shipping.

backorder.description: Identifies whether the order is in a backordered state.

cod.description: Represents any COD amount applicable to the order.

rma.description: Return authorization number associated with the order.

load_information.description: Load-level shipping details including BOL, PRO number, and load sequence.

order_detail.description: Represents each individual item on an outbound order, including item number, quantities, shipped qty, backorder qty, weights, and line-level identifiers.

order_line_number.description: Indicates the sequence of the item inside the order.

item_number.description: Unique identifier of the ordered item.

qty.description: Total quantity requested for this item on the order.

qty_shipped.description: Quantity of the item that has been shipped.

backorder_quantity.description: Quantity of the item that could not be fulfilled and remains as backorder.

item_weight.description: Weight of a single unit of the item.

extended_weight.description: Total weight for all units of this line item.

unit_volume.description: Volume of a single unit of the item.

extended_volume.description: Total cubic volume for the line item.

unit of measure.description: Unit of measure used for ordering the item.

lot_number.description: Lot or batch identifier if the item is lot-controlled.

line_type.description: Classification of the line item (normal, special, kit, etc.).

haz_material.description: Indicates whether the line item is hazardous.

stacking_sequence.description: Sequence used for stacking items during packing/palletizing.

afo_plan_qty.description: Planned quantity for allocation or fulfillment.

tran_plan_qty.description: Planned transaction quantity for picking or allocation.

picking_flow1.description: Flow or path used for picking the line item.

host_wave_id.description: Identifies the wave batch that the line belongs to.

b_o_l_details.description: Bill of Lading related details for the item line.

date_expected.description: Expected date for this item line to be fulfilled or shipped.

item_master_id.description: Reference to item in master data.

order_number1.description: Order number to which this line belongs.

order_id1.description: Foreign key linking the line item to t_order.

pick_detail.description: Stores each picking transaction and status for an item during outbound processing.

order_number2.description: Order for which the picking task is created.

item_number1.description: Item being picked from the warehouse.

lot_number1.description: Lot or batch ID if item is lot-controlled.

pick_id.description: Unique identifier for each pick task.

pick_location.description: Location from which the item is picked.

staging_location.description: Location where picked items are moved before loading.

zone.description: Zone to which the pick location belongs.

picked_quantity.description: Quantity actually picked by the operator.

loaded_quantity.description: Quantity loaded onto the truck or container.

unplanned_quantity.description: Quantity picked without a planned allocation.

Status.description: Current picking progress stage (picked, staged, loaded, etc.).

uom.description: Unit of measure for the item being picked.

work_q_id.description: Reference to work queue entry that generated the pick.

work_type.description: Type of warehouse work the pick belongs to.

wave_id.description: Wave to which the pick belongs.

load_sequence.description: Sequence in which items were loaded.

stop_id.description: Delivery stop linked to the load.

container_id.description: Container or carton used during picking/loading.

user_assigned.description: Warehouse operator assigned to pick the item.

wh_id.description: Warehouse where the pick transaction occurred.

common_warehouse_phrases.description: Operational phrases warehouse users commonly ask for pick-related queries.

item_identification.description: Main product identifier warehouse users search by every day

quantity_on_hand.description: Total physical quantity currently in the bin/location

available_quantity.description: Quantity workers are actually allowed to pick right now

unavailable_blocked_qty.description: Quantity that exists but cannot be picked (damage, QC hold, etc.)

stock_status.description: Quick yes/no flag: A = good to pick, U = do not touch

warehouse stock.description: Which warehouse/site the stock is in

location_bin.description: Exact bin or slot where the item is physically stored

forward_pick_pickface.description: Fast-moving pick slots right at the front for quick picking

reserve_bulk_storage.description: Deep storage / bulk area where pallets are kept

putaway_location.description: Where receiving team should put newly arrived stock

fifo_receipt_date.description: Date item came in – used to pick oldest stock first

expiration_date.description: When the product expires – 1900-01-01 means no expiry

reserved_stock.description: Stock already promised to an order – cannot be picked for anything else

owner_customer.description: Who actually owns the stock (important in 3PL warehouses)

item_type_handling.description: Special handling rules (dangerous goods, fridge, freezer, etc.)

quality_inspection.description: Result of quality inspection – often why stock is blocked

negative_stock.description: System shows negative when more was picked than physically existed

common_warehouse_questions.description: Exact everyday phrases warehouse workers will ask the chatbot

pallet_id.description: Unique identifier of a handling unit (pallet, carton, tote, etc.)

pallet_type.description: Physical container type of the handling unit

pallet_label_barcode.description: Printed or scannable number on the handling unit label

where_is_pallet.description: Current physical storage location of the handling unit

pallet_status.description: Handling unit status: A = Available for picking, U = Unavailable / Blocked

pallet_date.description: Receipt or creation date of the handling unit used for FIFO logic

zone_department.description: Designated zone or department within the warehouse

reserved_locked.description: Indicates the handling unit is reserved or allocated to a specific order

parent_pallet.description: Parent handling unit (e.g., pallet) that contains this child unit

truck_load.description: Outbound load or truck to which the handling unit is assigned

loading_position.description: Loading sequence or position of the handling unit on the trailer

hazardous materials.description: Flag indicating the handling unit contains hazardous materials

special_areas.description: Non-standard functional locations outside regular bin storage

daily_pallet_questions.description: Common natural-language queries warehouse users ask about handling units

pallet_contents.description: Common requests to see everything stored on a specific pallet or carton

pallet_or_carton_id.description: Identifier workers scan or type to look up a pallet or carton

item_sku_on_pallet.description: Product code or SKU stored on the pallet

how_much_on_this_pallet.description: Actual physical quantity of the item currently on this pallet

available_to_pick_from_pallet.description: Whether the line on the pallet is allowed to be picked (A = yes)

pallet_location.description: Current physical location of the entire pallet

oldest_date_on_pallet.description: Receipt or manufacture date used to pick oldest stock first

expiry_on_pallet.description: Expiration date of the item on this pallet

lot_batch_on_pallet.description: Lot or batch identifier for the items on this pallet

serial_numbers_on_pallet.description: List of serial numbers for serialized items on this pallet

customer_owner_of_pallet.description: Customer or entity that owns the inventory on this pallet

special_storage_on_pallet.description: Special storage requirements or zone for this pallet

who_built_packed_pallet.description: Employee who created or last worked on this pallet

pallet_picking_method.description: Defined picking flow or method for items on this pallet

transaction.description: Represents a single warehouse transaction such as picking, putaway, transfer, cycle count, return, or adjustment.

transaction_type.description: Indicates the type of warehouse activity performed (e.g., pick, putaway, move, adjustment).

transaction_description.description: Textual description of the transaction performed.

start_time.description: Date and time when the warehouse activity started.

end_time.description: Date and time when the warehouse activity finished.

employee.description: Primary warehouse operator who executed the transaction.

employee_secondary.description: Secondary warehouse operator associated with the activity (if any).

order_reference.description: Order reference number or internal control number linked to the activity.

line_reference.description: Line-level detail associated with the order reference.

external_reference.description: External identifier associated with the transaction (if any).

location.description: Primary location involved in the transaction.

location_secondary.description: Secondary location used in move/transfer-type activities.

handling_unit.description: Source handling unit involved in the transaction.

handling_unit_secondary.description: Target handling unit used for transfers or consolidation.

item.description: Item number associated with the transaction.

lot.description: Lot number for the item involved in the activity.

quantity.description: Number of units moved, picked, counted, or adjusted.

unit_of_measure.description: Unit of measure used for the transaction quantity.

verify_status.description: Indicates whether the activity was verified or audited.

routing.description: Workflow routing code used to classify the warehouse activity.

return_disposition.description: Return or exception disposition associated with the transaction.

audit_fields.description: Audit metadata used for historical tracking and archiving.

order_identification.description: Terms related to unique identification of orders and order lines, linking line-level data to main orders. Important for tracking archived transactions in historical tables.

item_and_inventory_details.description: Item-level details including SKU, description, customer parts, lot numbers, packaging, and weights/volumes. Critical for historical inventory tracking and reporting.

quantities_and_allocations.description: Terms related to ordered quantities, backorders, allocations, shipped quantities, and over-allocated items. Used to track historical fulfillment and shipment metrics.

shipping_and_logistics.description: Shipping and logistic details including Bill of Lading info, picking flows, waves, line types, stacking sequences, and expected shipment dates. Important for historical shipment and compliance reporting.

hazard_and_compliance.description: Hazardous material flags to ensure compliance and proper handling of archived items.

system_and_tracking.description: Terms used for system tracking and historical auditing. Reflects when the archived order line was created or last modified.

historical_usage.description: Terms emphasizing that this table stores historical or older order line transactions. Users querying past orders should use this table rather than live WMS tables.

Order Basics.description: General info that identifies an order and shows what stage it's in.

Customer Info.description: Simple customer details used to identify who the order belongs to.

Shipping Details.description: Everything related to how the order moves through the shipping process.

Address Info.description: Locations where the order goes, is billed to, or gets returned.

Order Metrics.description: Physical stats about what is being shipped.

Archive & History.description: Terms used for older orders stored long-term for history, lookups, and audits.

Live vs Archived Orders.description: Casual ways to talk about the difference between fresh orders and older archived ones.

Pick Basics.description: Core info that explains what picking action was performed and which order line it belongs to.

Product & Tracking Info.description: Details that identify the product and any lot or serial tracking tied to quality, compliance, or audits.

Quantity Details.description: Simple quantity checkpoints that show what was expected versus what actually moved through each picking stage.

Location & Flow.description: Where the product was picked from, where it moved next, and the warehouse pathways involved.

Work Assignment.description: Who performed the work and what kind of task group or method was used to carry out the pick.

Load & Outbound.description: All the outbound details tying the picked items to a load, route, container, or wave.

Warehouse Context.description: General warehouse-level identifiers showing where the work happened and how it was grouped.

Live vs Archived Picks.description: Easy ways to describe the difference between real-time pick activity and archived historical records.

Inventory Identification.description: Defines the identity and physical context of the inventory item, including what the item is, where it is stored, and how it is classified (lot or serial-controlled, transaction type, etc.).

Stock Quantities & Status.description: Represents the current inventory levels at a location, distinguishing between usable and unusable stock based on condition or system restrictions.

Ownership & Control.description: Captures ownership and reservation attributes used in 3PL, customer-specific stock management, or order reservation processes.

Lifecycle & Rotation Management.description: Manages stock aging and rotation using FIFO and expiration tracking for items requiring time-sensitive handling, like perishables or regulated goods.

Quality & Compliance.description: Supports quality control processes by marking stock under inspection or quality check holds, impacting usability for operations.

Operational Planning.description: Includes data used by the system for task planning, especially where items are scheduled to be placed during putaway or relocation.

System Control & Technical Fields.description: Internal system fields used for technical ordering and processing of inventory records, without direct business operation implications.

Order Identification & Structure.description: Defines the identity and structure of each order line within a warehouse order. Ensures linkage to the overall order header, warehouse location, and external systems via wave planning or integration references.

Item & SKU Details.description: Captures detailed SKU-level information including system item references, customer-specific part numbers, stacking logic, and lot control for regulated or traceable items.

Quantity Tracking & Fulfillment Status.description: Manages the fulfillment lifecycle of each order line by tracking how much was ordered, allocated, backordered, shipped, or over-committed, supporting real-time visibility and SLA adherence.

Weights, Volumes & Packaging.description: Supports load planning, freight calculation, and compliance documentation by storing detailed dimensional data and packaging attributes at the unit and line level.

Hazardous Materials & BOL Compliance.description: Enables safety and regulatory compliance by flagging hazardous materials and storing all required Bill of Lading (BOL) data for shipping documentation and placarding.

Execution Planning & Picking Flow.description: Supports warehouse execution by defining when and how an order line should be picked, packed, and delivered. Ties into wave planning and fulfillment strategies like FIFO, zone picking, or customer-specific flows.

Location Identification & Structure.description: Defines the physical and logical identity of each storage location within a warehouse. Includes unique identifiers, zoning/grouping, replenishment relationships, and coordinate mapping for warehouse navigation.

Capacity & Utilization.description: Tracks the physical storage limits and current utilization of each location. Supports space optimization and location selection logic for picking, putaway, and replenishment.

Operational Status & Rules.description: Defines the operational readiness and business rules governing the use of the location. Includes status flags, cycle counting parameters, and picking strategy indicators.

Maintenance & Audit Tracking.description: Captures operational history and maintenance records for each location. Ensures auditability, physical accuracy, and scheduling of cycle counting and inspections.

Physical Attributes & Dimensions.description: Represents the physical dimensions and placement of the location within the warehouse layout. These attributes are critical for warehouse mapping and automation systems.

Custom & Configurable Fields.description: User-defined fields to support business-specific extensions such as classification tags, business units, or custom logic not covered by standard attributes.

Archival & Backup Configuration.description: Defines the core parameters that specify which source table data is archived or backed up, the method used, selection conditions, how often the process runs, and the procedure executing the process.

Execution Tracking & Monitoring.description: Tracks the progress and outcome of archival and backup operations to ensure successful execution, troubleshooting, and auditability.

Historical Data Management.description: Manages naming conventions and storage location for archived or backed-up data, enabling consistent and traceable history table management.

Control Type Definition.description: Defines each archival or backup operation type, providing a unique code and a detailed explanation of its purpose and behavior.

Execution Procedure Mapping.description: Links each control type to the specific stored procedure responsible for carrying out the archival or backup action.

Metadata & Audit.description: Tracks when the control type record was created or last updated to ensure current and accurate definitions.

Mapping Definition.description: Defines the relationship between a live operational table and its corresponding archive or historical table, including naming conventions and storage location.

Metadata & Auditing.description: Records the date and time when the mapping configuration was created or last modified, ensuring traceability and version control.

Classification Management.description: Defines item storage classes within a warehouse, including classification ID and description, plus overflow handling and putaway allocation rules.

Overflow Handling.description: Specifies the fallback class to store items when the primary class reaches capacity.

Putaway Allocation.description: Controls the proportion of incoming items directed to this class to optimize warehouse space utilization.

Class-to-Location Mapping.description: Defines the mapping between storage classes and physical warehouse locations, specifying where items of each class can be stored.

Putaway Priority.description: Determines the priority or sequence in which locations should be filled for a given class to optimize space utilization.

Container Classification.description: Defines standardized classes of containers such as 'Box', 'Carton', or 'Pallet' used across warehouse operations.

Warehouse Operations.description: Supports identification and management of container types during key warehouse activities to ensure optimized storage and movement.

Reporting and Compliance.description: Provides transparency into the types of containers used across the warehouse for operational and compliance purposes.

Integration.description: Supplies container class definitions to various warehouse systems for consistent categorization and process management.

Container Classification Mapping.description: Defines which specific container types are allowed under each container class within a warehouse to standardize packaging and handling.

Operational Consistency.description: Ensures only approved container type-class combinations are used during receiving, storage, and shipment to prevent errors and maintain process consistency.

Validation & Compliance.description: Used by operational systems to validate container usage against warehouse-defined standards for quality control and compliance.

Reporting & Integration.description: Supports reporting and integration with warehouse management and enterprise systems by providing standardized container-class-type mappings.

Label Print Tracking for Unknown POs.description: Records label printing events for purchase orders that are not yet registered or recognized in the warehouse system, ensuring label activity is tracked even before PO data is fully available.

Operational Visibility.description: Provides visibility into label usage for POs pending validation or creation, supporting operational teams in tracking, troubleshooting, and reconciling label counts with eventual PO data.

Bridging Physical and System Processes.description: Acts as a bridge between physical label printing activities and formal PO processing, enabling smooth transition and reconciliation once PO master data becomes available.

Tote Master Record.description: Maintains the master or header record for totes used in routing, dispatching, and sorting operations within the warehouse, uniquely identified by warehouse, queue, and tote IDs.

Routing and Dispatch Control.description: Supports warehouse operations by controlling tote routing through zones, associating totes with processing queues and optionally customer orders, and tracking tote status and progression.

Operational Visibility and Auditing.description: Enables auditability and performance tracking of totes through timestamps of status changes, facilitating management and analysis of tote movements and processing stages.

Tote Movement Tracking.description: Tracks the real-time movement and status of totes within specific sorting and routing zones in the warehouse, uniquely identified by warehouse, queue, tote, and zone.

Operational Control.description: Enables operational workflows such as routing decisions, exception management, and SLA monitoring by providing timely tote status updates across zones.

Real-Time Visibility.description: Supports live tracking and visibility of tote status to warehouse staff and automated systems for efficient sorting and dispatch.

Identification and Reference.description: Unique identifiers and references for each pick task, including the pick record ID, outbound order details, item specifics, and lot/serial tracking.

Quantity Metrics.description: Tracks the quantities of items planned, actually picked, staged for loading, loaded onto shipments, and any unplanned picks to ensure accuracy and auditing.

Location and Zone.description: Physical warehouse locations related to picking and staging as well as the operational zones and designated pick areas within the warehouse.

Workflow and Processing.description: Information related to the picking process type, units of measure, work queue and type, current status, picking workflow details, bulk picking indicators, and stacking order.

Wave and Load Planning.description: Grouping and sequencing details that associate picks with waves (batches), loading units, load sequence for shipment, and stops in delivery routing.

Container and Packaging.description: Information on containers used for the pick, cartonization batch identifiers for packing optimization, and pick category classification.

User and Warehouse Context.description: Details linking the pick to the assigned user (picker/operator) and the warehouse identifier to maintain location context.

Item Reference.description: Identifies the airbag-specific product for which the predefined pricing is set. Used to link with item master and order lines for price application.

Pricing Information.description: Stores the predefined price value used for airbag item calculations during order entry, quoting, billing, and audit.

Business Usage.description: Supports consistent and auditable pricing for airbag-related products across order lifecycle—from entry to invoicing—and aids in compliance and margin analysis.

Resource Identification.description: Unique identifier used throughout the system to link UI components, dropdowns, and messages to their multilingual text equivalents.

Locale Configuration.description: Represents the language and regional format of the translation, enabling rendering of content in the appropriate user-preferred locale (e.g., 1033 = English - US).

Localized Content.description: The actual translated string shown to the user, supporting multilingual display for labels, messages, and dropdown values.

Resource Context.description: Internal field used to describe the purpose, usage, or context of the resource for translators, administrators, or developers.

Lookup Definition.description: Represents the functional or application context (e.g., module, screen, UI group) where the lookup value is used. Drives multilingual behavior based on usage grouping.

Lookup Identifier.description: A numeric ID that uniquely identifies a specific lookup option within the given usage. Used in forms, dropdowns, or configuration logic.

Resource Mapping.description: Links the lookup value to a multilingual text resource, allowing the application to display the correct label or message in the user’s preferred language.

Log Metadata.description: Metadata that uniquely identifies each log entry and captures the exact time the event occurred. Enables chronological tracing and filtering of system events.

Log Severity.description: Indicates the importance or severity of a log event, typically using numeric codes (1=ERROR, 2=WARNING, 3=INFO). Helps prioritize operational and support attention.

Log Content.description: Contains the full textual message describing the system event, warning, or error. May include module info, error numbers, or contextual messages for debugging.

Adjustment Identification.description: Captures key identifiers and classification details for each inventory adjustment, including batch references and reasons for change.

Item and Stock Info.description: Defines the product, lot, packaging unit, and ownership involved in the inventory change. Links to item master and ownership definitions.

Quantity and Inventory State.description: Tracks the exact quantity and status changes during adjustment for traceability and financial reconciliation.

Location Movement.description: Details the physical movement of inventory within the warehouse — useful for identifying transfers, putaway corrections, or misplacement fixes.

User and Audit Information.description: Captures who made the adjustment and when, enabling auditability and user-level accountability for inventory changes.

Trigger Identification.description: Identifies when and why a cycle count was triggered, capturing the trigger ID, operational context, and timestamp for audit and tracking purposes.

Operational Linkage.description: Links the cycle count trigger to an associated work queue task, providing operational traceability between trigger and execution.

Audit and User Info.description: Captures who or what initiated the trigger, enabling accountability and filtering between manual and system-generated cycle counts.

Approval Identification.description: Unique identifier and status of a cycle count approval entry, recording when and how an approval or rejection decision was made.

Cycle Count Task Reference.description: Links the approval record to the specific cycle count task, ensuring traceability between approval decisions and the cycle count activity.

Inventory Context.description: Defines the inventory context for the approval, specifying the warehouse, item, location, and optionally the handling unit involved.

Approval Workflow Details.description: Captures user and system actors involved in the approval lifecycle, including who approved, rejected, or triggered the count, and timestamps for these actions.

Audit and Compliance.description: Supports regulatory and internal audit requirements by maintaining a clear, accountable record of all approval decisions related to cycle counts.

Test Task Identification.description: Unique identifier for a simulated hose-cutting pick task in a test or staging environment.

Location Context.description: Specifies the location from which the hose material is picked during the test scenario.

Cutting Details.description: Describes the cutting requirements, including whether cutting is needed, the quantity to pick, the length to cut, and the resulting handling unit identifier.

Workflow Simulation.description: Tracks the current processing state of the test cut task and simulates back-office system integration readiness.

Testing Purpose.description: Used exclusively for safely simulating hose cutting operations, validating business logic, and testing integrations without affecting live warehouse data.

Pick Task.description: Unique identifier for the warehouse picking task associated with a hose cutting instruction.

Storage Location.description: Specifies the warehouse location from which the hose material is picked for cutting.

Handling Unit Identifier.description: Unique identifier for the handling unit created after the hose has been cut.

Cut Requirement.description: Indicates whether the hose material needs to be cut (Y) or not (N) as part of the pick task.

Quantity and Length.description: The amount of hose to be picked (pick_qty) and the length to be cut from bulk or reel (cut_length), used for fulfillment accuracy.

Back Office Integration.description: Flag indicating if the cut instruction record is eligible for synchronization with back-office or ERP systems.

Operational Status.description: Tracks the current status of the hose cut instruction (e.g., PENDING, PICKED, DONE) to monitor progress in warehouse workflows.

Box Flag ID.description: Unique identifier for each boxing flag entry applied to an order at a distribution centre.

Distribution Centre Code.description: Code representing the specific distribution or logistics centre where the boxing flag applies.

Order Number.description: Unique identifier of the outbound or inbound order associated with the boxing flag.

Box Flag.description: Short code representing the boxing or packaging status of the order, such as boxed, excluded, or special handling.

Flag Type.description: Category or type of the boxing flag, distinguishing operational flags, exclusions, or other classifications.

Flag Validity Dates.description: Date range during which the boxing flag is applicable, allowing for time-bound rules or overrides.

Manifest Code.description: Optional code linking the order flag to a shipping manifest or grouping for outbound logistics.

Item Comment ID.description: Unique identifier for each item-specific comment record.

Item Master ID.description: Optional foreign key linking the comment to the detailed item master record.

Item Number.description: Unique code identifying the item to which the comment applies.

Warehouse ID.description: Code representing the warehouse where the comment and related operations apply.

Activity Type.description: Code indicating the type of warehouse activity the comment pertains to, such as picking (PK), receiving (RC), or packing (PA).

Comment Sequence.description: Ordering sequence for multiple comments linked to the same item and activity type, ensuring proper display order.

Comment Text.description: Text containing specific instructions or notes regarding item handling, quality checks, packaging, or picking.

Type.description: Defines the category or type of handling unit (e.g., pallet, carton).

Control Number.description: An optional control number used for tracking or identification purposes within warehouse operations.

Location ID.description: The physical location within the warehouse where the handling unit is stored.

Subtype.description: Further categorizes the handling unit beyond the primary type.

FIFO Date.description: Date used to enforce FIFO picking rules for inventory rotation.

Load ID.description: Identifier linking the HU to a specific shipment load or transportation batch.

Load Sequence & Position.description: Specifies the order and position of the handling unit within a load or shipment.

Hazardous Material Flag (haz_material).description: Indicates whether the handling unit contains hazardous materials.

Parent Handling Unit ID (parent_hu_id).description: Reference to a parent handling unit for nested containers or multi-level packaging.

Reserved For.description: Indicates if the HU is reserved for a specific purpose or order.

Container Type.description: Type of container the handling unit represents (e.g., PALLET, BOX).

Stop ID.description: Identifier for the transport stop or delivery location associated with the HU.

User ID.description: User who created or last modified the handling unit record.

Version Flag (ver_flag).description: Flag used for version control or record state management.

Employee ID (employee_id).description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each warehouse employee.

Login ID (id).description: Unique login identifier used by the employee to access warehouse systems.

Name.description: The full name or display name of the employee.

Password.description: Password associated with the employee's login credentials.

Employee Number (emp_number).description: Additional numeric or alphanumeric identifier for the employee.

Function Code.description: Code representing the employees job function or role within the warehouse.

Department (dept).description: Department or unit within the organization to which the employee belongs.

Supervisor.description: Identifier of the employee's supervisor or manager.

Menu Level.description: Defines the employees system menu access level or permissions.

Warehouse ID (wh_id).description: Identifier of the warehouse where the employee is assigned or operates.

Work Queue ID (work_q_id).description: Identifier of the work queue or task group assigned to the employee.

Return Date.description: Date when the employee returns to work, if applicable.

Handling Unit ID (hu_id).description: Identifier for any handling unit assigned to the employee.

Zone.description: Warehouse zone or area where the employee is assigned.

Temporary Menu Level (temp_menu_level).description: Temporary system menu access level granted to the employee.

Device.description: Identifier of the device or terminal assigned to the employee.

Current Location.description: Physical or logical location of the employee within the warehouse.

Log ID.description: Identifier for the employees current or last system session.

Priority Threshold.description: Threshold value for prioritizing tasks assigned to the employee.

Hours Into Future.description: Number of hours ahead for which the employees tasks are scheduled (default 12).

SP Return.description: Code or flag related to special returns handled by the employee.

Locale ID.description: Locale identifier for system language or regional settings (default 1033 for English - US).

User ID & Domain.description: Information about the users system account and domain.

Audit Required.description: Flag indicating if actions by this employee require auditing.

Work Shift.description: Code representing the employees assigned work shift.

Pick Area.description: Specific area within the warehouse assigned for picking tasks.

Carrier Code.description: Unique business code representing the carrier in the system.

Carrier Name.description: Full name of the transportation carrier.

Carrier Group ID.description: Identifier used to group carriers for routing, assignment, or optimization purposes.

Contact Name.description: Name of the primary contact person for the carrier.

CDL Verify.description: Indicates if CDL verification is required for drivers (e.g., 'YES' or 'NO').

Time Allowed Early.description: Number of minutes early the carrier is allowed to arrive before scheduled time.

Time Allowed Late.description: Number of minutes late the carrier is allowed to arrive after scheduled time.

Disposition.description: Instructions or rules on how to handle early or late carrier arrivals.

Default Trailer Type ID.description: Identifier for the carrier's default trailer or equipment type.

Default Priority.description: Default priority assigned to the carrier for routing or scheduling.

Dock Schedule Method.description: Method used for dock scheduling with this carrier.

Notes.description: Free-text notes or remarks related to the carrier.

Transport Mode.description: Type of transport mode used by the carrier (e.g., PARCEL, LTL, TL, AIR, OCEAN).

Tender Response Time.description: Time in minutes the carrier has to respond to a tender request.

SCAC Code.description: Unique SCAC code used for regulatory compliance and electronic data interchange.

Effective Date.description: Date when the carrier record or status becomes effective.

Freight Forwarder Flag.description: Flag indicating if the carrier is a freight forwarder ('Y' or 'N').

Address Fields.description: Carrier's physical address and location information.

Communication Details.description: Phone, fax, email, and extension numbers for carrier communication.

Taxpayer ID.description: Taxpayer identification number for financial and billing processes.

Network ID.description: Identifier used by carrier's internal or external network systems.

Alternate Names.description: Alternative names or aliases for the carrier.

Language Code.description: Language code used for communication with the carrier.

House Type.description: Custom classification or house type designation.

Geo Code.description: Geographical code representing the carrier's location.

In City Limit.description: Flag indicating if the carrier's address is within city limits ('Y' or 'N').

EDI Message Identifiers.description: Technical names used for EDI messages such as tender requests, cancellations, tracking, and proof of delivery.

Carrier Organization ID.description: Identifier linking the carrier to a larger organizational entity.

Disposition Code.description: A unique code representing the status or handling condition of materials or items, such as 'QCHOLD' for Quality Check Hold or 'SCRAP' for scrapped materials.

Location Type.description: A single-character code indicating the type of location associated with the disposition, guiding where items with this status should be stored or routed.

Use Case.description: Defines how materials are classified and handled during receiving, inspection, quality assurance, and stock movements.

Description.description: A brief, human-readable title or description of the document.

URL.description: The file path or URL where the document can be accessed.

Document ID.description: Foreign key linking each content entry to its parent document.

Content ID.description: An integer defining the order or position of the content section within the document.

Content.description: Text representing the title or description of a document section or content item.

Equip-Equip-List ID.description: Unique identifier for each equipment-to-list association.

Equipment List ID.description: Foreign key referencing the equipment list or grouping.

Equip-Equip-Attrib ID.description: Unique identifier for each equipment-to-attribute association.

Equipment ID.description: Foreign key referencing the specific equipment item associated with an attribute.

Equipment Attribute ID.description: Foreign key referencing the attribute assigned to the equipment item.

Not Used For.description: Does not store attribute values or inventory data.

terms: foreign keys to equipment and equipment attribute
Relationships.description: Acts as a junction table linking equipment items to multiple attributes.

Equipment Identification.description: Unique identifiers and classifications to identify and categorize equipment types.

Physical Dimensions.description: Physical size specifications used for planning and compatibility checks.

Capacity Limits.description: Defines max and min load thresholds equipment can safely handle.

Descriptive Information.description: Optional textual details about the equipment type.

Attribute Identification.description: Unique identifiers and names for equipment attributes or features.

Attribute Description.description: Optional textual descriptions providing additional context or details about each equipment attribute.

List Identification.description: Unique identifier for each equipment list used to group multiple equipment records.

List Naming.description: A unique, descriptive name assigned to each equipment list to simplify identification and selection.

List Metrics.description: Optional informational count of how many equipment items are included in the list, primarily used for reference or validation.

Size Identification.description: Unique identifier for each equipment size category.

Size Naming.description: Unique, human-readable name describing the equipment size classification.

Size Description.description: Optional textual explanation providing additional context or detail about the equipment size.

Type Identification.description: Unique identifier for each equipment type category.

Type Naming.description: Unique, human-readable name describing the equipment type classification.

Type Description.description: Optional textual explanation providing additional context or detail about the equipment type.

Exception Identification.description: Defines the type and nature of the exception or override occurring in a warehouse transaction.

Exception Timing.description: Records the date and time when the exception or override was logged.

User & Responsibility.description: Identifies the employee or user who performed or logged the exception or override.

Warehouse & Location Context.description: Specifies the warehouse and physical location related to the exception event.

Item & Lot Details.description: Identifies the specific inventory item and lot associated with the exception.

Quantity & Handling Unit.description: Captures the quantity involved in the exception and the handling unit identifier.

Override Values.description: Tracks the systems suggested value versus the actual value entered during the exception.

Additional Identifiers.description: Supplementary fields for tracking and linking exceptions to specific transactions or documents.

Warehouse & Location.description: Specifies the warehouse and the designated forward pick location within the warehouse.

Replenishment Control.description: Thresholds and limits that control when and how much replenishment is triggered for the forward pick location.

Location Priority & Quantity Calculation.description: Defines the picking priority for the location and whether replenishment quantity should be dynamically calculated.

Handling Unit Identification.description: Defines the unique identifier for each handling unit and its physical location within the warehouse.

Item Identification & Tracking.description: Captures item-specific identifiers to support batch and serial tracking as well as inspection status within the handling unit.

Quantity Tracking.description: Tracks item quantities at various operational stages inside the handling unit to provide accurate inventory visibility.

Status & Lifecycle Management.description: Supports inventory lifecycle management including availability status, first-in-first-out rotation, expiry management, and version control.

Operational & Process Control.description: Includes operational data to manage process flows, employee actions, and sequence ordering of records during warehouse operations.

Classification & Ownership.description: Defines classification codes and ownership attributes used for freight handling, commodity categorization, stock ownership, and storage conditions.

UPC Identification.description: Manages the mapping of UPC barcodes to specific item numbers to enable quick and accurate product identification via scanning.

Item & Warehouse Linkage.description: Associates UPC codes with items and their corresponding warehouses to maintain unique and consistent barcode assignments across locations.

Data Integrity & Uniqueness.description: Ensures that each UPC assignment is unique per item per warehouse to avoid barcode duplication and maintain data consistency.

Locale Identification.description: Defines unique identifiers and descriptive names for system-supported locales, representing language-region combinations.

Localization Management.description: Manages whether a locale is currently active or inactive within the system, controlling its availability for user interfaces and reports.

Display & Ordering.description: Determines the order in which locales appear or are presented in the system based on a defined sequence number.

Application Usage.description: Supports the localization of system interfaces and messages to match the preferred language and regional settings of users or warehouses.

Location Relationship Identification.description: Defines unique pairs of warehouse locations and the specific type of relationship between them to support warehouse layout and operations.

Operational Areas & Zones.description: Specifies optional pick areas and zones linked to location relationships to support task routing and warehouse zoning strategies.

Relationship Status Management.description: Controls whether a specific location relationship is currently active or inactive, influencing operational logic and automation.

Warehouse Operations & Automation.description: Supports automation and enforcement of warehouse processes such as picking, putaway, and returns based on predefined location relations.

Task Dependency Identification.description: Defines the relationship between two work tasks in the warehouse where one task depends on the completion or status of another to start or proceed.

Dependency Management & Sequencing.description: Manages the sequence and logical order of task execution to ensure operations proceed correctly without conflicts or premature starts.

Operational Flow Control.description: Supports coordinated execution of related tasks in processes such as kit building, staging, assembly, and multi-zone picking to maintain operational integrity.

Work Type Identification.description: Defines unique identifiers and codes for different types of work tasks processed within the warehouse, including optional subtypes for task specialization.

Work Type Description & Classification.description: Classifies work tasks by category (e.g., PICK, MOVE), provides human-readable descriptions, indicates active/inactive status, and sets default priority for task scheduling.

Task Processing & Control.description: Controls how and when work tasks are released into the system by specifying stored procedures and business rules tied to each work type, supporting automated task assignment and prioritization.

Operational Usage & Workforce Planning.description: Enables planning and assignment of tasks to workers based on defined work types and their categories, ensuring operational consistency and efficiency.

Zone Identification.description: Defines the unique code and warehouse association that identifies each zone within a warehouse.

Zone Description & Classification.description: Captures the human-readable description and the functional classification of the zone such as CONVEYOR, OUT_ZONE, or others.

Overflow & Backup Zones.description: Specifies optional zones that serve as overflow or backup areas to handle excess inventory or tasks.

Warehouse & Zone Identification.description: Associates a warehouse and zone to define the operational area within the warehouse.

Location Mapping.description: Specifies the physical location within the warehouse that is assigned to a specific zone.

Pick Sequence & Routing.description: Defines the order or priority in which locations are picked within a zone to optimize picking paths and improve efficiency.

Kit & Warehouse Identification.description: Identifies the specific kit or assembly item and the warehouse context in which its bill of materials (BOM) is defined. Ensures BOMs are unique per kit and warehouse.

Component Item Details.description: Defines the specific item used as a component within a kit or assembly. Each entry represents one part of the full BOM for the kit.

Quantity & Material Requirements.description: Specifies how many units of the component item are needed to assemble one unit of the kit. Used in MRP, picking, and kitting processes.

Operational Usage.description: Used to define the structure of kits and assemblies, enabling component-level planning, inventory deduction during kitting, and traceability for compliance and quality control.

Image Identification & Association.description: Identifies each image uniquely and associates it with a specific item and warehouse context. This allows for correct linkage between visual data and item records across distributed environments.

Image Management & Metadata.description: Contains metadata that defines the properties and handling instructions for the image, including the display order (sequence), file type, and original or system-generated filename.

Image Content & Storage.description: Holds the actual binary image data used in UI displays, catalogs, and operational interfaces requiring visual confirmation or representation of the item.

System Constraints & Integrity.description: Ensures data integrity and consistency across records, preventing duplication, enforcing valid references to item master data, and supporting efficient access and indexing.

Business Application & Usage.description: Supports a wide range of operational and customer-facing use cases by enabling visual access to item data. Helps reduce errors, improve UX, and enhance quality and accuracy in physical and digital workflows.

Item Identification.description: Defines the core identity of the item, including internal (item_number) and external identifiers (alt_item_number, upc), along with classification codes for trade, regulatory, and scanning purposes.

Measurement & Physical Characteristics.description: Specifies how the item is measured and its physical properties, which are essential for logistics planning, cartonization, stacking, and freight calculations.

Inventory Behavior & Controls.description: Defines how the item is controlled within inventory operations, including tracking methods (serial or lot), cycle counting category, expiration control, and classification for inventory rules.

Replenishment & Planning.description: Supports inventory planning and automatic replenishment strategies by defining when and how much to reorder, as well as any default suggestions for handling excess or obsolete stock.

Quality & Inspection Management.description: Controls how quality inspections and cycle counting are managed, including audit requirements and inspection frequencies used during receiving or sampling processes.

Hazardous Materials & Compliance.description: Flags items subject to hazardous materials handling and international trade regulations. Supports safe storage, shipping, and customs compliance through NAFTA and MSDS data.

Warehouse Operations Configuration.description: Controls how the item is handled within warehouse processes like picking, putaway, cross-docking, and stacking. Links to operational profiles for task optimization and slotting.

Ownership, Versioning & Extended Attribu.description: Captures metadata about item ownership (used in 3PL scenarios), version control, and optional comments or classifications for internal management and reporting.

Item & Warehouse Context.description: Identifies the item, unit of measure, warehouse, and UOM pattern setup. Provides the context for where and how the UOM applies in warehouse operations.

Unit Conversion & Standardization.description: Defines the mathematical relationship between the base unit and the specified UOM, along with standard and allowable quantities used in handling or planning.

Dimensions & Volumetrics.description: Describes the physical size and volume of the item in the specified UOM, which is critical for space planning, cartonization, and pallet optimization.

Weight & Load Attributes.description: Specifies weights used in transportation, capacity planning, and safety-related stacking or load-bearing calculations.

Palletization & Layering.description: Defines how the UOM is structured for palletization, including layers per unit and stacking sequence logic, guiding how the item is placed on or within containers.

Pick & Receipt Behavior.description: Controls how the UOM is used in picking and receiving processes, including whether it is eligible for picking and its default behavior during inbound or outbound flows.

Orientation & Stacking Rules.description: Defines physical placement rules, such as allowable orientations and stacking restrictions, used by warehouse automation, cartonization, and load planning engines.

Cartonization & Packing.description: Indicates how the item in this UOM should be considered during packing and cartonization logic. Includes flags to isolate items or apply custom box constraints.

Integration & Display.description: Supports system integration and UI behavior through identifiers (e.g., GTIN for barcoding), display configuration, and links to automation profiles like pick/put strategies or VAS.

Special Handling Flags.description: Used for specific handling instructions, such as routing or placement in conveyor or hose-related operations, usually tied to item fragility or shape.

Dates & Order Lifecycle.description: Tracks all relevant milestone dates in the order lifecycle, supporting SLA monitoring, wave planning, and historical reporting.

Shipping & Carrier Information.description: Controls how the order is shipped, including freight terms, carrier selection, BOL/pro numbers, and special flags affecting routing, palletization, or hazardous handling.

Freight & Financials.description: Stores financial details related to freight, insurance, COD, and rate planning for transportation and billing integration.

Weight & Volume Metrics.description: Captures physical metrics used in load planning, carrier selection, and shipment execution.

Addresses Billing.description: Contains the billing address and contact information used for invoicing and financial documentation.

Addresses Shipping.description: Primary delivery location for the order; used in label generation, routing, and carrier planning.

Addresses Delivery.description: Optional final delivery location for complex routing scenarios or drop locations different from 'ship to'.

Addresses Freight Billing.description: Specifies the entity responsible for paying freight, which may differ from the main bill-to party.

Addresses Returns.description: Used in returns processing and RMA execution to define where return goods should be sent.

Returns & RMA.description: Tracks the return merchandise authorization reference, enabling return validation and processing control.

Execution & Planning Controls.description: Used during outbound execution to assign orders to loads, support partial shipments, or indicate backordered items.

Comment Identification & Linkage.description: Uniquely identifies the comment and ties it to the appropriate order and warehouse context. Provides linkage between comments and the corresponding sales order for reference, audit, or processing.

Comment Classification & Structure.description: Defines how the comment is categorized (e.g., header/footer, warehouse/system) and its position in a sequence of multiple comments for the same order. This structure supports correct rendering in documents and prioritization.

Comment Content & Timestamp.description: Stores the actual freeform content of the comment and records the creation time. This allows for audit tracking, chronological sorting, and contextual understanding of order-related notes.

Pick/Put Operation Identification.description: Identifies the specific pick or put operation and the operation type (e.g., PICK or PUT), linking to the master operation and rules.

Rule Definition & Reference.description: Specifies the rule applied during the pick/put operation (e.g., FIFO, Best Quantity), linking to predefined warehouse picking/putting logic.

Execution Sequencing.description: Defines the order in which rules are applied within the pick/put operation, ensuring proper process flow and prioritization.

Pick Method Identification1.description: Identifies the specific pick method being configured, linking to the pick method master table.

Pick Component Identification.description: Specifies the individual pick component that is part of the pick method, linking to the pick component master.

Execution Phase / Sequence.description: Defines the execution order (phase) in which each pick component is processed within the pick method, ensuring structured workflow.

Pick Method Identification2.description: Unique identifier for each pick method.

Pick Method Metadata.description: Human-readable name and descriptive details of the pick method.

Work Type.description: Categorizes the pick method based on the type of work or process it supports (e.g., Order Pick, Zone Pick).

order status.description: Indicates whether the pick method is active or inactive, controlling its availability in the system.

Pick Area Identification.description: Composite primary key identifying the warehouse and the specific pick area.

Pick Area Targets and Classification.description: Defines workload targets, type of work associated with the pick area, and container classification.

Descriptive Metadata.description: Textual description providing additional details about the pick area.

Comment Identification.description: Unique identifier for each comment, sequence to order multiple comments, and comment classification (default 'W').

Order Detail Linkage.description: References to the specific order detail record that the comment annotates.

Comment Metadata.description: Timestamp when the comment was added (default to current datetime).

Comment Content.description: The textual content of the comment, describing instructions, notes, or exceptions.

Pick Method Linkage.description: Foreign key linking to the pick method in t_pick_method, representing the picking strategy.

Menu Context.description: Specifies the menu level or application context where the pick method is applicable.

Menu Identifier.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each menu item.

Localization & Area.description: Locale controls language/region display; area_id separates application functional areas (e.g., Receipts, Orders).

Menu Structure.description: Defines menu hierarchy level (e.g., BASE, SUBMENU) and display order within that level.

Display Text.description: User-facing labels; 'name' is the short menu label, 'text' is a descriptive label.

Associated Process.description: Backend system process or function triggered when the menu item is selected.

transactions.description: Represents a single warehouse transaction such as picking, putaway, transfer, cycle count, return, or adjustment.

transactions type.description: Indicates the type of warehouse activity performed (e.g., pick, putaway, move, adjustment).

transactions description.description: Textual description of the transaction performed.

start time.description: Date and time when the warehouse activity started.

end time.description: Date and time when the warehouse activity finished.

employee_primary.description: Primary warehouse operator who executed the transaction.

employee secondary.description: Secondary warehouse operator associated with the activity (if any).

order reference.description: Order reference or internal control number linked to the transaction.

line reference.description: Line-level detail associated with the referenced order.

external reference.description: External identifier associated with the transaction.

location_primary.description: Primary location where the transaction occurred.

location secondary.description: Secondary location used for move or transfer transactions.

handling_unit_primary.description: Source handling unit involved in the transaction.

handling unit secondary.description: Target handling unit used for transfers or consolidation.

return disposition.description: Return or exception disposition for the transaction.

elapsed time.description: Total time taken to complete the transaction.

audit fields.description: System-generated history fields used for transaction archiving and audit trail.

work_queue.description: Single work assignment generated by the WMS such as picking, replenishment, putaway, or movement.

work q id.description: Unique identifier for each work queue task.

work type.description: Type of warehouse task such as pick, putaway, move, or replenish.

task_description.description: Textual explanation of the work task.

pick_reference.description: Outbound order reference linked to the work assignment.

priority.description: Priority level for completing the task.

due_time.description: Date and time by which the task must be completed.

items.description: Item associated with the work assignment.

warehouses.description: Warehouse where the work task is executed.

target_location.description: Location the item must be moved to or picked from.

source_location.description: Source location for movement, transfer, or replenishment tasks.

work status.description: Current state of the task: created, assigned, in-progress, completed.

Qty.description: Quantity of the item to be handled.

labor.description: Number of workers required and assigned.

Zones.description: Warehouse zone associated with the task.

employees.description: Employee assigned to execute the task.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the task record was created.

Audit.description: Historical audit metadata for the task record.

wh id.description: Identifies the warehouse where this location physically exists.

location_id.description: Unique identifier for the bin or slot inside the warehouse.

description.description: Text or label describing the location.

short_location_id.description: Shortened version of the location ID used for display and printing.

Location status.description: Defines whether the location is active, pending, blocked, or inactive.

Location ZONE.description: Functional area in the warehouse assigned to this location.

picking flow.description: Sequence used during picking operations for routing and pick optimization.

capacity_uom.description: Unit of measurement used to define the capacity of the location.

capacity_qty.description: Maximum storage quantity allowed in the location.

stored_qty.description: Actual quantity currently stored in the location.

location type.description: Classification of the location (e.g., I = Inventory, P = Pick, B = Bulk).

fifo_date.description: Oldest FIFO date among inventory stored in the location.

cycle_count_class.description: Defines how frequently the location must be cycle-counted.

last_count_date.description: Date when the location was last cycle counted.

last_physical_date.description: Date when the location underwent a physical inventory check.

user_count.description: Number of times a user manually performed counting in the location.

capacity_volume.description: Total volume capacity of the location.

time_between_maintenance.description: Time interval between scheduled maintenance activity for the location.

last_maintained.description: Date when the location was last serviced or maintained.

length.description: Physical length of the location (in warehouse dimensions).

replenishment_location_id.description: Location from where stock is replenished for this pick/active location.

allow_bulk_pick.description: Indicates whether bulk picking is permitted from this location.

slot_rank.description: Priority ranking used for slotting and pick optimization.

slot_status.description: Status of the slot during operations (active/blocked/etc.).

item_hu_indicator.description: Indicates whether handling units (HUs) can be stored in the location.

c1.description: User-defined custom attribute for the location.

c2.description: User-defined custom attribute for the location.

c3.description: User-defined custom attribute for the location.

random_cc.description: Indicates if the location is eligible for random cycle counting.

x_coordinate.description: X-axis coordinate of the location on the warehouse map.

y_coordinate.description: Y-axis coordinate of the location on the warehouse map.

z_coordinate.description: Vertical (height) coordinate of the location, representing rack level.

employee_id.description: Unique identifier for the employee used by the WMS.

id.description: Login ID used by the employee to access the WMS system.

password.description: Password used for authentication in WMS.

emp_number.description: Internal employee number or badge number assigned by HR or warehouse.

function_code.description: Role/function assigned to the employee (e.g., picker, receiver, admin).

dept.description: Department to which the employee belongs.

supervisor.description: Supervisor or manager responsible for this employee.

menu_level.description: Defines the user interface access level for the employee in WMS.

WHSE.description: Warehouse where the employee is assigned to work.

WORK ID.description: Specifies the work queue to which this employee is assigned.

employee status.description: Current status of the employee (active, inactive, suspended).

return_date.description: Expected return date if the employee is on leave or inactive.

hu_id.description: Handling unit associated with the employee (for forklift or device use).

zones.description: Zone in which the employee is authorized to perform work.

temp_menu_level.description: Temporary user access level assigned for special tasks.

device.description: Device assigned to the employee for scanning and operations.

current_location.description: Location where the employee last operated or logged activity.

log_id.description: System log identifier for tracking employee session data.

priority_threshold.description: Defines the maximum priority level of tasks the employee can receive.

hours_into_future.description: Number of hours into the future the system considers when assigning tasks.

sp_return.description: Internal system use parameter for employee-specific returns.

user_id.description: System-generated identifier for the user profile.

user_domain.description: Domain used for authentication and access security.

audit_required.description: Indicates if the employees actions require audit tracking.

work_shift.description: Work shift assigned to the employee.

pick area.description: Picking area where the employee performs order picking.

DATE_TIME_H.description: System timestamp for when the record was last updated.

ID_H.description: Unique system-generated identifier for historical tracking.
